How to plan a week for a small team

By Jane Doe, 1 September 2026

Plan the week on Monday morning, in thirty minutes, with the whole team. List the tasks, give each one an owner, and spread them across the days.

Give every task one owner

A task with two owners has none. Name one person for each task, and let them ask for help when they need it.

Leave room for the unexpected

Fill four days out of five. The fifth absorbs the work nobody saw coming. When you are ready, compare the plans and prices or go back to the weekly planner.
